movedToAdmin.title: People management is in Team › Administration
movedToAdmin.body: Members, invitations, roles, rights, portfolio visibility and team rules are set in one place. Data sharing and the workspace market stay here.

header.title: Team
header.subtitle: Manage the members of {{name}} and their access.
header.roleAndStageHint: Your role and your firm’s size shape {{copilot}}’s recommendations: set them in your <profileLink>profile</profileLink>.
header.theoTagline: Clear responsibilities, explicit access and handovers without loss.

errors.load: Unable to load your team. Please try again in a moment.

sections.peopleSummary_one: {{count}} active member · {{seats}} seats on your plan.
sections.peopleSummary_other: {{count}} active members · {{seats}} seats on your plan.
sections.rights: A role does not replace consent.
sections.rightsHint: Who sees which accounts, and what leaves the workspace. A right specific to one person is set from their “Role” button.
sections.rulesHint: The workspace market and the team policy {{copilot}} applies to everyone’s day.

invite.title: Invite a teammate
invite.seatsFull: All your seats are in use. <upgradeLink>Upgrade your plan</upgradeLink> to invite more people.
invite.description: The email goes out when you confirm. You can resend or revoke it from the list.
invite.dialogDescription: The invitation is sent when you confirm; you can resend or revoke it.

member.crossTeamSupportHelp: Backs up the others on every account without owning any.
member.roleHint: The role decides what the person sees and does in the workspace.
member.roleBounded: Explicitly bounded rights: a technical role does not grant a financial view, and no role opens a personal mailbox.

handover.title: {{name}} is leaving
handover.description: See what this person is carrying before you decide. Handing over their portfolio does not remove their seat — that is usually the notice-period move.

transfers.title: What changes hands
transfers.failed: Unable to read their portfolio. Please try again in a moment.

plan.title: Split between several colleagues
plan.help: Pick one recipient per type. You see the summary before anything moves; nothing is deleted.

toast.failed: The split could not be done

personal.title: What is never handed over
personal.help: These are personal: they stay with their owner and are given to nobody.

handover.learned: What your team learned about these accounts — records, notes, history, angles — belongs to the workspace: nothing is lost and nothing needs moving.

successor.title: Who takes over
successor.aria: Pick the person taking over the portfolio
successor.none: No other member can carry a portfolio today. Invite someone, or remove the seat: the portfolio will go back to the unassigned queue.

toast.failed: The handover could not be completed

invitations.resendSent: Email sent: the new link is valid for 7 days.
invitations.resendNotSent: Email not sent: the link is renewed, but nothing went out. Try again or pass it on yourself.
invitations.emptyTitle: Nobody is waiting for an invitation.
invitations.emptyHint: Invite with the right role: the email goes out when you confirm, and you can resend or revoke it.

readOnly.viewer: Your role (Viewer) is read-only: you cannot modify the team.
readOnly.other: Only the owner, admins and Sales Ops can invite or remove members.

toast.permissionsError: The permissions could not be saved
toast.crossTeamSupportError: The change could not be saved
toast.invitationResentNotSent: The link for {{email}} is renewed, but the email did not go out

needAuth.title: Join the team
needAuth.description: Sign in to {{brand}} to accept this invitation. Use the email address the invitation was sent to.

accepting.title: Accepting…
accepting.description: We're adding you to the workspace.

error.title: Invitation unavailable
error.fallback: The invitation could not be accepted

workspaces.title: My workspaces
workspaces.subtitle: You belong to several workspaces. Switching changes the accounts, contacts and analyses you see — nothing is moved or merged.

community.title: Share access intelligence
community.help: What your team declares about entering an account — closed panel, way in through a subsidiary, mandated prime — is pooled anonymously. As soon as three distinct workspaces confirm the same thing, it becomes reliable and comes back to you on your own accounts.
community.never: Never pooled: a placed consultant’s name, a day rate, a contact, the content of an exchange, or the identity of the workspace that declared it. A workspace that does not share does not consume.
community.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can turn this on.
community.enabled: Sharing on. Your access declarations feed the community, and you receive its own.
community.disabled: Sharing off. Nothing leaves this workspace — and nothing enters it.
community.failed: The setting could not be saved

portfolio.title: Who sees which accounts
portfolio.help: By default every member sees the workspace's whole portfolio — that is what stops two reps calling the same company. Some firms cannot work that way: individual commission, competing teams on one market, subcontracting.

open.label: Open to the whole team
open.help: Every member sees the workspace's entire portfolio.

restricted.label: Partitioned per rep
restricted.help: Each rep sees their own accounts and the ones nobody owns. Managers keep seeing the whole portfolio — without it they can neither assign nor rebalance it.

portfolio.unreadable: The current setting cannot be displayed here yet: no option is shown as active until it has been read. Picking one applies it to the whole workspace.
portfolio.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can change this setting: it is the only one that changes what the whole team sees at once.

applied.open: Portfolios opened to the whole team.
applied.restricted: Portfolios partitioned per rep. Unassigned accounts stay visible to everyone.

portfolio.failed: The partitioning could not be saved

permissions.title: Own permissions — {{name}}
permissions.explain: You are granting these permissions to {{name}}, on top of their role ({{role}}). The action is recorded in the activity log, under {{grantedBy}}.
permissions.ownerHasEverything: The owner already has every permission.

joinRequests.unknown: Someone with no name on file
joinRequests.error: The decision was not saved. Try again in a moment.

teamPolicy.title: Team policy
teamPolicy.subtitle: The rules {{copilot}} applies when she organises everyone’s day or week.
teamPolicy.error: The team policy couldn’t be loaded.
teamPolicy.none: No team policy set: {{copilot}} organises days without team rules.

prospecting.label: Protected prospecting windows
prospecting.hint: No meetings: only calls, research, enrichment and follow-ups are suggested there.

teamPolicy.windowDays: Days of window {{index}} (none chosen: every day)
teamPolicy.windowInvalid: A window ends after it starts, and two windows never overlap.
teamPolicy.saveFailed: The team policy couldn’t be saved.

workspaceMerge.title: Bring my personal space over
workspaceMerge.subtitle: Copies the accounts and contacts of “{{source}}” into “{{target}}”. Nothing moves before your approval AND an administrator of {{target}}’s. Your personal space is then archived: its data stays readable, nothing is deleted.
workspaceMerge.empty: Your personal space has no account or contact to bring over.
workspaceMerge.proposalsTitle: Already in {{target}} — merge proposed, never done on its own:
workspaceMerge.awaiting: Preview approved. Waiting for a decision from an administrator of {{target}}.
workspaceMerge.failed: The transfer stopped. Nothing was copied twice: resuming starts again from the last processed row.
workspaceMerge.done: Brought into {{target}}. Your personal space is archived: its data stays readable, nothing was deleted.
workspaceMerge.rejected: An administrator of {{target}} declined this transfer. You can preview again.
workspaceMerge.error: That didn’t go through. Try again in a moment.

rulesAside.title: Rules set the frame.
rulesAside.body: Tasks stay in Actions, campaigns in Sequences. Automations have no implicit right to send.
